calls.title: Fireflies Demo Meeting
calls.summary: The discussion highlighted a desktop application designed for automatic meeting detection, facilitating seamless user engagement from the start of meetings. Users receive notifications to join or record meetings, supporting both bot-assisted and silent audio recording for flexibility and privacy. An intuitive Live Assist panel is integrated for real-time management, featuring sections for transcripts, AI-generated notes, and meeting prep. The app incorporates calendar functions for efficient meeting scheduling, providing timely alerts and prep notes. Additionally, user-controlled privacy settings enhance trust and data management. Overall, the solution differentiates itself in the market by combining automation with user control.
calls.keywords: Fireflies desktop app, Meeting detection, Live Assist panel, Note-taker bot, Real-time transcript, Meeting recording options
calls.action_items:
**Scott**
Download and install the Fireflies desktop app from the profile menu at fireflies.ai to enable automatic meeting detection and recording features (00:10)
Set meeting preferences including language and auto-recording options within the app settings to customize meeting capture behavior (01:20)
Grant microphone and system audio recording permissions to the Fireflies desktop app to ensure full meeting capture functionality (01:35)
Choose the recording method for each meeting by either inviting the Fireflies note-taker bot for full features or using device audio recording for privacy (01:45)
Use the Live Assist floating panel during meetings to monitor real-time transcript, AI-generated notes, and meeting prep context for enhanced engagement and productivity (02:45)
